notes: Verdigris builds VeraFlow — a VS Code extension that provides streaming inline completions, multi-line refactor suggestions, and on-the-fly test generation. requirements_summary:
- Workload: VS Code inline assistant with streaming completion, multi-line refactor suggestions, and embeddings for code search.
- Latency: target p50 start-of-stream 30-70ms; p95 end-to-end under 400ms for 3s outputs.
- Throughput: expected 2k-3k requests/min peak across org; per-seat bursts up to 50 req/min.
- Model needs: open/quantized models ok, but require stable pinned versions and rollout controls.
- Observability: token-level cost, trace to user sessions, per-route latency dashboards.
- Security: SSO (SAML), customer KMS support, audit logs retention 1yr, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Operational: want canary rollouts, automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on capacity pressure.
poC_scope: 48h Dedicated pool with model pinning + KV prefix caching. Validate: streaming start latency, consistency across 100K simulated editor completions, tenant rate-limits and seat quotas, KMS-encrypted keys. Deliverable: perf report + suggested Optimize config (batch sizes, quantization) and cost estimate.
decision_criteria: Latency & jitter < target, predictable per-seat billing, security signoff (SOC2 + DPA), and clear rollback/variant routing. If Dedicated hits targets, convert to 1yr reserved commit. Otherwise consider hybrid (hosted + Private for EU customers).
